# Overview

This notebook computes the phenotype or signature scores that will later be tested against MOFA factors.

# Setup

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(edgeR)

source("helpers/helpers_from_MOFA.R")

project_id <- "PROJECT_ID"
score_column <- "C1_score"
class_column <- "C1_class"

dir.create("output/tables", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("output/figures", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

rna <- readr::read_tsv("input/tables/RNA_MATCHED.tsv", show_col_types = FALSE)
metadata <- readr::read_tsv("input/tables/sample_metadata.tsv", show_col_types = FALSE)
signature_tbl <- readr::read_csv("input/tables/signature_genes.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

# Score Construction

```{r}
feature_col <- colnames(rna)[1]
sample_ids <- setdiff(colnames(rna), feature_col)
count_mat <- as.matrix(rna[, sample_ids, drop = FALSE])
rownames(count_mat) <- rna[[feature_col]]

logcpm <- compute_logcpm(count_mat)
signature_genes <- intersect(signature_tbl$gene, rownames(logcpm))
stopifnot(length(signature_genes) > 0)

score_vec <- colMeans(logcpm[signature_genes, , drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
score_tbl <- tibble::tibble(
  sample_id = names(score_vec),
  !!score_column := as.numeric(scale(score_vec))
)

score_tbl[[class_column]] <- class_from_z(score_tbl[[score_column]])
metadata_scored <- dplyr::left_join(metadata, score_tbl, by = "sample_id")

readr::write_tsv(
  metadata_scored,
  file.path("output/tables", paste0(project_id, "_scored_metadata.tsv"))
)
```

# Quick Checks

```{r}
ggplot(metadata_scored, aes(x = .data[[class_column]], y = .data[[score_column]], fill = .data[[class_column]])) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.2, size = 0.4) +
  theme_bw(11)
```
